title: WO resolves missing facts to approved neutral wording in the site language and validates slot provenance
steps: From the checkout, run the command in run.
Check the domain tests and the tests reading the three committed slot-role sidecars. No database or network is needed.
expect: Every neutral key used by the vocabulary and sidecars resolves in all ten site languages; unknown locales fall back to English.
Contact requires a contact page, email or phone; Call requires a phone even when its policy omits the requirement.
Step indices 0 and 1 render 01 and 02; missing facts never create people, prices, claims or forbidden filler.
The manifest accepts the four supported states and rejects duplicate slots, invalid fields and contradictory provenance.
